items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lalo Schifrin was the musical arranger of that program and the arranger of my recording called Conga Soul. There are several numbers there composed by him and me.

ctx.x: Ahá, exactly - Candi's Funk. The arranger was the Argentine, Carlos Franzetti. And there is another called Conga Soul where the arranger was Lalo Schifrin.
